text.en:
Dispositive Action. The NFA is hereby transferred from the
Department of Agriculture to the Office of the President.

Scope of Transfer. The transfer shall be limited to policy and program
coordination/integration and administrative supervision.

Mode of Transfer. The Administrator of the NFA shall immediatety
prepare and with the approval of the President, shall implement short- and long-term
plans and programs on grains procurement, storage and marketing consistent with the over-
all policy of agricultural development.

Repealing Clause. All executive orders, rules and regulations, and other
issuances or parts thereof that shall be inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive
order are hereby either revoked or modified accordingty.

Effectivity. This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
Nineteen Hundred and Ninety-Eight.
DONE in the cily of Mail, this I ih day of Jun the year of Our Lord,
By the President:
RONALDO B. ZAMORA
Executive Secretary
